Strict backup descendant/directchild/no symlinks/nlink1/exact3checksums; current metadata<65536/index<1024 are real bounded input policies. Size/RPO/source-version/application/credential mismatch rejected before restore; age measured from started epoch, not completion.
Latest lexicographic complete backup directory chosen among valid nonsymlink directories, not CONFIG Latest; explicit backup task selected for restore. Incomplete directories remain charged.

Restore only different server and empty DB; exact owners/ACLs retained, pg_restore single transaction/exit on error. Original credential/system/image/version closure required; no same-server restore, clean, deletion or inferred successful application acceptance.

Existing scheduled mode verifies recent backup then may create new; interval vs RPO separate. verify bypasses mutation flock by design; backup/restore/migrate use kernel exclusive nonblocking lock. Invocation args task data, not second policy author.
